environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'data-pipeline' with Istio 1.20 sidecar injection enabled (istio-injection=enabled label). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the mesh level with a DENY action for workloads where source.namespace is not in ['data-pipeline', 'kafka-system']. The Kafka brokers run in 'kafka-system' namespace with mTLS STRICT PeerAuthentication. Additionally, a Sidecar resource scopes egress to './*' and 'kafka-system/*' only. The processor pod has an Envoy sidecar that terminates connections from pods outside the allowed namespaces before they reach the Kafka port. Cross-namespace producers attempting TCP connections to kafka-system:9092 receive RST from the Envoy proxy enforcing the authorization policy.
